scene: Atop the gate, three busy transit docks stretch into the night sky.
picture: A flat side view along the tiled rooftop platform atop the moon gate. On the far left hangs a round cloud cable pod with an open hatch. In the centre, the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man stands with his ukulele beside a waiting bullet train. On the right, a solar-sail junk floats moored to a post.
shown: A round cable pod hanging open on an overhead wire on the left
A sleek bullet train with open sliding doors in the centre
A wooden junk ship with glowing solar sails moored on the right
